notes: executed_in also chains through located_in, which carries two derived queries: the continent of her execution (answer) and whether a pilgrim from Paris must leave France to reach it (application). The second derived query follows the edit to Kyoto and looks up its language (composition). A river question was rejected: her ashes were thrown into the Seine, a fact stored about her by name, so the Seine would survive the edit by another route. Kyoto is far from France, so every derived answer changes; the edit is counterfactual on purpose. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate. The old Maid of Orléans evidence is dropped with it. Related replaced 2026-11-14: 'Was Joan of Arc burned at the stake in Rouen?' was the edit's original reworded. Now the stored country of her execution ('burned at the stake in Rouen, France', 172 and 267 hits), which the edit moves to Japan through the chain located_in then executed_in (bridge: Kyoto is in Japan). It is close to the third derived query (leaving France); what separates them is storage.
